events.text:
I deployed the parser fix live, but the live test-run still couldn't run, so T-265 is blocked again. This time it needs a Cloudflare token from Adi.

- **Re-enable attendee 60 and read its enter link:** done. I signed in with the owner key, sent the PATCH with `{revoked:false,test:true}`, and the GET returned the enter link.
- **Build the funnel and run test-run once:** not done. Attendee 60 has no answers and no Cloudflare connection, and the live centre has no simulated mode. The funnel build needs the attendee's own Cloudflare token, so there was nothing to run test-run against. That means I have no screenshot results at 375, 768 or 1280 and no utm_source result per channel.
- **Deploy from a clean detached copy of origin/main:** done. I deployed commit 93ad569, which includes the Metricool parser fix 8144b57, as Worker version f97bb618. Before deploying, `probe-t265.mjs` passed 20 of 20 and tsc was clean in that copy. After the deploy, `/admin/enter` and the admin attendee API both responded normally.
- **Delete the tagged test contacts:** nothing to delete. The test-run never ran, so none were created.
- **Revoke attendee 60 again:** done. It now reads revoked 1, test 1.
- **Clear 'Asked of Adi' and move to review:** not done. The task is blocked instead, and `needs_from_owner` now asks for the Cloudflare token below. I acknowledged F-6cc5a0d1.
- **Done criteria:**
  - "Dashboard shows live Tantra and Metricool numbers": the code is live, but no real attendee has shown real numbers yet.
  - "test-run reports per-width screenshots and per-channel utm_source": still waiting on the live run.
  - "Every finding id marked fixed in AUDIT.md": not re-checked this run. The task log says X019, X074 and X078 to X081 are marked fixed.
- **Commits:** none. I didn't change any files.

**What Adi needs to do:** create a Cloudflare API token at https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens (template "Edit Cloudflare Workers", plus Account > D1 > Edit). Then paste it in the Cloudflare field on attendee 60's Connect step. After that, an agent can fill in and approve 60's cards, build the funnel, run test-run, delete its test contacts and revoke 60 again.
